title: Fine properties of functions in complex Sobolev spaces
summary: We study comprehensively local properties of functions in complex Sobolev spaces on a bounded open subset of $\mathbb{C}^n$. The main tool is the corresponding functional capacity for the space which is inspired by the global one due to Vigny (2007). An inequality between this capacity and the Bedford-Taylor capacity for plurisubharmonic functions is proved, which is sharp as far as the exponents are concerned.
